issues.detail: Spec S03 does not specify the reset value of start_shifting; contract chooses 0.
issues.alternative: Reset terminates the found-hold but does not clear start_shifting, so it remains 1 after reset.

issues.detail: Spec S02 does not specify start_shifting before detection; contract chooses 0.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: start_shifting initializes to 1 before any detection and remains 1 until reset.

issues.detail: reset.first_released_cycle says the first reset==0 edge leaves FSM S0, while R3 processes data on reset==0 as S0+1->S1; a first 1 after reset can be ignored.
